Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Plugin Files Release Notifier

on:
  push:
    branches: ['master']

  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release-notifier:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Get changes
        run: |
          $any_changed = $false
          $watch_files = @(
            "scintilla/include/Scintilla.h",
            "scintilla/include/Sci_Position.h",
            "PowerEditor/src/MISC/PluginsManager/Notepad_plus_msgs.h",
            "PowerEditor/src/MISC/PluginsManager/PluginInterface.h",
            "PowerEditor/src/menuCmdID.h",
            "PowerEditor/src/WinControls/DockingWnd/Docking.h",
            "PowerEditor/src/WinControls/DockingWnd/dockingResource.h"
          )
          if("${{ github.event_name }}" -eq "workflow_dispatch") {
            #Write-Output "non-push: use HEAD~1..HEAD, which isn't as specific, but better than nothing"
            $changed_files = @( git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD )
          } else {
            #Write-Output "for-push: use before/after"
            $changed_files = @( git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.event.after }} )
          }
          foreach ($this_file in $changed_files) {
            #Write-Output "the following is different: $this_file"
            if( $this_file -in $watch_files ) {
              Write-Output "+ Saw changes in: $this_file"
              $any_changed = $true
            }
          }
          if($any_changed) {
            $map = @(
              @( "${{ secrets.PAT_NOTIFY_NPPPLUGINS }}", "npp-plugins/plugintemplate", "CI_update_remote.yml" ),
              @( "${{ secrets.PAT_NOTIFY_NPPPLUGINS }}", "npp-plugins/plugindemo", "CI_update_remote.yml" )
            )

            foreach ($target in $map) {
              $pat = $target[0]
              $ref = $target[1]
              $yml = $target[2]
              # Write-Output "DEBUG: len(pat)='$($pat.Length)' ref='$ref' len(ref)=$($ref.Length) yml='$yml' len(yml)=$($yml.Length): 'https://api.github.com/repos/$ref/actions/workflows/$yml/dispatches'"
              Write-Output "Notifying '$ref' workflow '$yml' using curl 'https://api.github.com/repos/$ref/actions/workflows/$yml/dispatches'."
              curl -s -L `
                -X POST `
                -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" `
                -H "Authorization: Bearer $pat" `
                -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" `
                https://api.github.com/repos/$ref/actions/workflows/$yml/dispatches `
                -d "{`"ref`": `"${{ github.ref_name }}`", `"inputs`": {}}"   
              # NOTE: if there is a problem with the curl call, there will be a message in the workflow output,
              # but the workflow will not fail, so that the Notepad++ build will not fail; we do our best to notify,
              # but we don't want a problem with another repo holding up a N++ fix.
            }
          } else {
            Write-Output "No watched-files changed, so not sending notification to plugin templates this time."
          }

results.content:
Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
trigger CI for each submitted revision


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
omit a revision only under an approved skip policy

results.content:
Pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows

Pattern: P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE (failing_schedule_suppression)

When is pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows applicable?

Assess pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: A monitored pause/resume policy is approved

Contraindications: Continuous monitoring or periodic checks are mandatory

Method: Notify the owner when pausing; Define an explicit recovery and reactivation path

Reported finding: Failure-streak suppression offers estimated savings.

Reported metrics: {"consecutive_failure_threshold": 3, "paid_total_vm_time_reduction_percent": 3.2}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.1; Tables 5-6; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
keep running a repeatedly failing scheduled workflow


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
pause after an approved failure streak and notify the owner

@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@

-keep running a repeatedly failing scheduled workflow
+pause after an approved failure streak and notify the owner
contraindications: Continuous monitoring or periodic checks are mandatory
preconditions: A monitored pause/resume policy is approved

results.content:
Suppress schedules during repository inactivity

Pattern: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (scheduled_run_reduction)

When is suppress schedules during repository inactivity applicable?

Assess suppress schedules during repository inactivity for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Periodic results depend only on repository changes

Contraindications: External dependencies, security or time-based requirements need fresh checks

Method: Identify meaningful activity rather than generated self-updates; Resume when relevant inputs change

Reported finding: Inactivity suppression saves some scheduled work.

Reported metrics: {"paid_scheduled_vm_time_reduction_percent": 1.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.2; Table 5; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

run on every schedule tick
